items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I see it was 1923 and when he came in 1923, he joined Lionel Howard's Musical Aces and also around 1925 he accompanied singers like Viola McCoy, Lena Wilson, Clara Smith and Sarah-- I don't know who this person is --

ctx.x: Yes. Yes, I'm pretty sure that. For a while it was very difficult to convince the audience that she could sing without all those things, but this had nothing to do with her voice or her renditions, it was just that the audience expected to hear all that big background and it just wasn't there, and I'm pretty sure that now, when Sarah or -- well, you know for certain that when these girls go on their tours that they work with their rhythm section group because they can improvise, they can really stretch out and…
But with just a small group or trio behind you they can more nimbly adapt themselves to what --
